blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: How multimodal language models should encode visual input remains up for debate. Most models use a pretrained vision encoder, while some recent recipes train the encoder from scratch with the language model or remove it entirely. Vision encoders bundle together three design choices: a visual prior from upstream pretraining, dedicated vision capacity, and pre-fusion placement of that capacity (i.e., before the multimodal backbone). Because published models also differ in data, architecture, and compute, comparing them cannot isolate the effect of each choice. We disentangle these choices via a controlled framework where we pretrain all models from scratch on common data and compare them on visual question answering and language benchmarks at matched lifetime compute. We find that the visual prior is not necessary; an encoder trained jointly from scratch is on par with a pretrained one, without a separate training stage. What matters instead is dedicated vision capacity: an encoder-free model trails on visual understanding even when its backbone is enlarged by the encoder's parameter count. Yet that capacity need not precede multimodal fusion, as vision-only modules added in-fusion to early backbone layers perform comparably to a pre-fusion encoder and can lower time to first token. These results also hold across backbone sizes, when encoder pretraining is treated as free, and when starting from a pretrained language model. Overall, our findings favor dedicated vision capacity trained jointly with the backbone and placed early within it.
blocks.zh: 多种语文模式应如何编码视觉投入的问题仍有待讨论。 大多数模型使用预先训练的视觉编码器,而一些近期的食谱则用语言模型从头开始训练编码器或者完全去除. 视觉编码器将三个设计选择组合在一起:上游预训前的视觉、专用视觉能力以及这种能力的预置(即在多式联运主干线之前)。 因为公布的模型在数据,架构,和计算上也有所不同,因此比较它们不能孤立每个选择的效果. 我们通过一个控制框架来解析这些选择, 将所有模型从头到尾地从共同数据中筛选出来, 在视觉问题答案和语言基准上进行比较, 在相应的寿命计算中。 我们认为,视觉前置没有必要;从头开始联合训练的编码器与预先训练的编码相同,没有单独的训练阶段。 而重要的是专用的视觉能力:一个没有编码器的模型跟踪视觉理解,即使它的骨干被编码器的参数计数所扩大. 然而,这种能力不需要在多式联运之前,因为仅将视觉模块添加到早期骨干层中,其性能与核聚变前的编码器相当,并且可以将时间缩短到第一。 这些结果也持有跨骨干大小,当编码器预训作为免费处理时,以及从预训语言模型开始. 总体而言,我们的调查结果倾向于与骨干部门共同培训专门的愿景能力,并尽早将其纳入其中。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Most multimodal models acquire visual understanding from a vision encoder pretrained for a separate objective, such as image recognition or image–text alignment, rather than from being trained directly with the multimodal backbone that uses its features ( He et al., 2016 ; Radford et al., 2021 ; Tschannen et al., 2025 ; Siméoni et al., 2026 ; Tschannen et al., 2023 ) .
Multimodal training has progressed from freezing this encoder ( Alayrac et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2023b ; Liu et al., 2023 ; Muse Glimmer Team, 2026 ) to updating it ( Beyer et al., 2024 ; Bai et al., 2025a ) , but encoder pretraining has remained a separate stage.
Recent recipes bring vision and language closer by discarding parts of the pretrained encoder setup: Kimi K3 trains a vision encoder from scratch jointly with the multimodal backbone ( Kimi Team, 2026b ) , and encoder-free models directly process pixel patches, forcing visual encoding to be learned entirely within the backbone ( Adept AI, 2023 ; Diao et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Gemma Team, 2026 ; Thinking Machines
Lab, 2026a ) .
Each recipe implies a different answer to what the vision encoder contributes, if anything at all.
We ask which of its inherited design choices benefit multimodal models trained entirely from scratch.

我们问,其继承的设计选择中,哪一种从零开始就对训练的多式联运模式有利。

blocks.en:
The predominant multimodal vision encoding recipes bundle together three design choices:
(i) a visual prior from upstream pretraining,
(ii) dedicated vision capacity (i.e. , parameters that only vision tokens use),
and (iii) pre-fusion placement of that capacity in a separate encoder that operates before vision and text tokens interact in the backbone—rather than operating in-fusion , within the shared backbone.
A pretrained encoder keeps all three, a from-scratch encoder gives up only the prior, and an encoder-free model gives up all three.
blocks.zh:
主要的多模式构想编码方法将三种设计选择结合在一起:
(一) 上游预训前的视觉,
(二) 专用视觉能力(即仅使用视觉标志的参数),
和(三) 将这种能力预先装入单独的编码器,在视觉和文字符号在骨干中相互作用之前运作,而不是在共用骨干内操作。
一个预先训练的编码器保留了全部三个,一个从scratch编码器放弃的只是前作,一个没有编码器的模型放弃了全部三个.

blocks.en:
Existing comparisons cannot isolate these choices, for two reasons.
First, they entangle the choices with each other and the rest of the recipe.
Published models differ in data, training stages, compute, and architecture.
While controlled studies hold multimodal training data and compute fixed, their comparisons among pretrained encoders ( McKinzie et al., 2024 ; Tong et al., 2024a ; Fan et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ) vary which visual prior an encoder imports rather than whether it needs one in the first place.
Studies of encoder-based vs. encoder-free models either change all three choices ( Tong et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) or change capacity and placement together ( Shukor et al., 2025 ) .
Second, comparisons with pretrained encoders control only multimodal training, treating encoder pretraining as free even though it adds substantial compute and data of its own (e.g. , SigLIP 2 trains on 40B image–text samples; Tschannen et al., 2025 ), and several studies attribute the encoder’s advantage to its pretraining ( Lei et al., 2025 ; Diao et al., 2025 ) .

现有的比较不能孤立这些选择,原因有两个。
首先,它们把选择和其余的食谱纠缠在一起。
公布的模型在数据,培训阶段,计算,和架构方面各不相同.
虽然受控研究持有多式培训数据并进行固定计算,但它们在预先培训的编码器中的比较(McKinzie等,2024年;Tong等,2024年a;Fan等,2025年;Li等,2025年)在编码器进口之前的视差不同,而不是最初是否需要编码器。
基于编码器与无编码器模型的研究要么改变所有三种选择(Tong等,2026;Liu等,2026),要么改变容量和放置在一起(Shukor等,2025)。
其次,与预先培训的编码器进行比较,只控制多式联运培训,将编码器预培训视为免费培训,尽管它增加了大量计算和自己的数据(例如,40B图像-文本样本上的SigLIP 2列车;Tschannn等人,2025年),还有几项研究将编码器的优势归因于其预培训(Lei等人,2025年;Diao等人,2025年)。

blocks.en:
In this work, we conduct a controlled study that unbundles the design choices of multimodal vision encoding one at a time ( fig. 1 ):
(i) does the vision encoder need separate pretraining? (ii) does vision encoding need dedicated capacity? and (iii) does that capacity need to precede multimodal fusion? We train every model entirely from scratch, language backbone included, on a common pool of data with one encoder architecture, one dense backbone architecture, and one optimization recipe.
We evaluate models on downstream visual question-answering (VQA) and language benchmarks at backbone sizes from 0.6B to 6.4B.
Because recipes spend compute in different stages, we compare them at matched lifetime compute : the total compute of all training stages, including any pretraining of the encoder or language model.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们进行一项有控制的研究,将多式联运愿景的设计选择一并解开(见图一)。 1 个:
(一)视觉编码器是否需要单独的预训? (二) 视觉编码是否需要专门的能力? 和(三) 这种能力是否必须先于多式联运? 我们完全从零开始训练每个模型, 包括语言骨干, 在一个共同的数据库中, 一个编码器结构, 一个密集的骨干结构, 一个优化的食谱。
我们评价下游视觉问答(VQA)的模型以及主干大小从0.6B到6.4B的语言基准.
因为食谱在不同阶段计算, 所有培训阶段的总计算,包括编码器或语言模型的任何预训。

blocks.en:
Our experiments answer these questions and test whether the answers hold beyond lifetime compute: 1. Separate pretraining is optional (§ 3 ).
At matched lifetime compute, a from-scratch encoder is on par with encoders pretrained on the same data.
Even if we ignore upstream compute (§ 6.1 ), more encoder pretraining improves recognition but not VQA. 2. Dedicated vision capacity is key (§ 4 ).
An encoder-free model trails an encoder-based model on visual understanding, even when its backbone is enlarged by the encoder’s parameter count.
The encoder’s advantage thus lies in capacity dedicated to vision rather than in total parameter count. 3. Vision capacity can move in-fusion (§ 5 ).
Adding vision-only capacity to the backbone’s earliest layers is comparable to adding a from-scratch pre-fusion encoder.
Scaling laws show in-fusion tracking the encoder, whereas encoder-free trails it at every size (§ 5.4 ). 4. The findings hold beyond lifetime compute (§ 6 ).
Starting from a pretrained 1.7B language model, in-fusion stays comparable to the from-scratch encoder while encoder-free falls further behind.
In-fusion can also lower time to first token, since no separate encoder must run before the backbone.

在匹配的寿命计算中,一个从scratch编码器与在同一数据上预先训练的编码器处于等同状态.

blocks.en: 2 A controlled protocol for comparing multimodal recipes
blocks.zh: 2个 用于比较多式配方的控制协议

blocks.en:
We propose a protocol that varies the three design choices a vision encoder bundles, while holding fixed the data sources, optimization settings, compute, and backbone architecture. This isolates their effects when comparing current multimodal model recipes.
Conclusions about these design choices cannot be drawn from comparing published models, because they differ in several factors at once—e.g. , they build on different pretrained language models and vision encoders that each vary in training data and compute.
We therefore use no external pretrained models: we train every component from scratch, with common data sources and training setups, and compare recipes at matched lifetime compute , the total compute of all training stages.
blocks.zh:
我们提出一个协议 改变三个设计选择 一个视觉编码器捆绑, 同时持有固定的数据源, 优化设置,计算, 和主干结构。 这在比较目前的多模式模式配方时孤立了它们的效果.
关于这些设计选择的结论不能从比较已公布的模型中得出,因为它们同时在几个因素上有所不同——例如,它们建立在不同的预先训练的语言模型和视觉编码器上,每个模型在培训数据和计算上都各不相同.
因此,我们没有使用外部预先培训的模型:我们从零开始培训每个组件,使用共同的数据来源和培训设置,并在相应的寿命计算时比较配方,即所有培训阶段的总计算。

blocks.en: 2.1 Recipes and the fusion boundary
blocks.zh: 2.1 食谱和聚变边界

blocks.en: Table 1: Unbundling the encoder’s design choices. A pretrained encoder bundles all three; in-fusion keeps only dedicated vision capacity.
blocks.zh: 表1:解开编码器的设计选择。 被预先训练的编码器包了所有三个;内聚能只保留专用的视觉能力.

blocks.en: All recipes differ only in how they encode visual input.
blocks.zh: 所有食谱仅在编码视觉输入方式上有所不同.

blocks.en:
Our backbones use an architecture modeled after Qwen3 ( Yang et al., 2025 ) : a dense, decoder-only, pre-norm Transformer ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) with RMSNorm ( Zhang and Sennrich, 2019 ) , RoPE ( Su et al., 2024 ) , SwiGLU feed-forward layers ( Shazeer, 2020 ) , and grouped-query attention ( Ainslie et al., 2023 ) with query–key normalization ( Dehghani et al., 2023 ) ( section A.1 ).
Our main comparisons ( sections 3 , 4 and 5 ) use the Qwen3 1.7B and 4B configurations with dedicated vision capacity fixed at 0.4B parameters, and our scaling study ( section 5.4 ) uses a 0.6B–6.4B ladder that grows vision capacity in proportion to the backbone.
Training uses autoregressive cross-entropy on text tokens; vision tokens precede the text they condition and have no loss.
Each image’s vision tokens attend to each other bidirectionally and text tokens attend causally to all earlier tokens, including vision tokens ( section A.4 ).
blocks.zh:
我们的骨干采用了以Quen3 (Yang等,2025年)为模型的建筑:一个密集的,只有解码器的,规范前变形器(Vaswani等,2017年),有RMSNorm (Zhang and Sennrich, 2019年),RoPE (Su等, 2024年),SwiGLU向上分层(Shazeer, 2020年),以及分组-query关注(Ainslie等, 2023年),有查询-键态(Dehghani等, 2023年)(A.1节).
我们的主要比较(第3、4和5节)采用专门视觉容量固定在0.4B参数的Quen3 1.7B和4B配置,我们的缩放研究(第5.4节)采用0.6B-6.4B梯级,视能与骨干成正比地增长。
培训在文字符号上采用自旋相交;视觉符号在文字之前附加条件,没有损失。
每个图像的视觉标志是双向的,文本标志是所有早期的标志,包括视觉标志(A.4节)。

blocks.en:
We describe how image patches reach the backbone relative to the multimodal fusion boundary , the first layer in which vision and text tokens can interact: vision-only computation before it is pre-fusion and computation inside the shared backbone is in-fusion ( figs. 1 and 1 ).
Scratch encoders ( ) process image patches pre-fusion with a randomly initialized 27-layer, 0.4B-parameter Vision Transformer ( Dosovitskiy et al., 2021 ; Alabdulmohsin et al., 2023 ) modeled after MoonViT-V2 (Kimi K3’s encoder; Kimi Team, 2026b ), whose output is linearly projected into the backbone.
Pretrained encoders ( ) share this architecture, but we first pretrain them ourselves on our common data ( section 2.2 ) rather than taking external checkpoints.
Encoder-free models ( ) map patches directly into the backbone with a linear patch embedding ( Adept AI, 2023 ; Gemma Team, 2026 ) , followed by RMSNorm and a learned scalar gate ( Qi et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) .
In-fusion models ( ) instead add vision-only modules inside the backbone ( section 5 ).
Every recipe trains on 224 × 224 224\times 224 images, read as 256 vision tokens using 14 × 14 14\times 14 patches.
Instruction tuning for evaluation raises the resolution to 448 × 448 448\times 448 (1,024 vision tokens), as in PaliGemma’s short high-resolution stage ( Beyer et al., 2024 ) , since OCR and chart reading needs fine detail ( Tong et al., 2024a ; Beyer, 2024 ) .

blocks.en: 2.2 Common data
blocks.zh: 2.2 共同数据

blocks.en:
Text-only sequences come from Nemotron-CC v2/v2.1 ( NVIDIA, 2025b ; NVIDIA, 2025a ) , and image–text sequences use MetaCLIP 1.2 pairs (English subset) ( Xu et al., 2024 ) .
Encoder pretraining uses these pairs with their original alt-text, as in each objective’s original setup ( section 3 ; e.g. , CapPa, Tschannen et al., 2023 ), while multimodal training uses captions regenerated by Qwen2.5-VL-32B ( Bai et al., 2025b ) and shared by every recipe.
Multimodal training mixes text-only and image–text sequences 70:30, so recipes with a pretrained encoder spend more lifetime compute on image–text data.
This matches the language share Han et al. (2026) found optimal and gave the best visual understanding in our sweep at a small cost to text ( section A.4 ).

blocks.en: 2.3 Lifetime compute
blocks.zh: 2.3 寿命计算

blocks.en:
Multimodal models often build on separately pretrained components whose training can even exceed the multimodal stage.
For example, SigLIP 2, a commonly used encoder, is trained on 40B image–text samples ( Tschannen et al., 2025 ) , which translates to 10 trillion image tokens, while language models are typically also trained on trillions of text tokens ( Touvron et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) .
Counting only multimodal training therefore favors recipes that spend more compute in these earlier stages.
To make such comparisons fair, we propose lifetime compute , the total training compute of every stage that produces the final model, C lifetime = ∑ s ∈ 𝒮 C s , C_{\mathrm{lifetime}}=\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}}C_{s}, (1) where 𝒮 \mathcal{S} is the set of training stages and C s C_{s} is the training compute of stage s s .
Here, 𝒮 \mathcal{S} contains multimodal training, any text-only training before it and, for pretrained encoders, encoder pretraining, but not instruction tuning.
We report compute in FLOPs; because recipes differ in cost per token, matched compute means that they process different numbers of tokens. Section A.5 describes the compute accounting and converts each budget into token-equivalents, the number of tokens a text-only model of the same size would process with the same compute.
Lifetime compute models a project that allocates one budget across every training stage, which lets us separate the contribution of each design choice.
In practice, pretrained encoders are often available for free, so we also compare encoders with their pretraining compute not counted ( section 6.1 ).

blocks.en: 2.4 Training schedule
blocks.zh: 2.4 培训时间表

blocks.en:
To compare recipes at many training lengths from one run ( Zhai et al., 2022 ) , we use a warmup–stable–decay schedule ( Hu et al., 2024 ; Wen et al., 2025 ; Hägele et al., 2024 ) , where the learning rate stays constant after warmup and any checkpoint of that run can be decayed to 5% of its peak over the final 10% of training ( section A.3 ).
Our main comparisons span compute budgets from 6.5 × 10 20 6.5\times 10^{20} to 2.9 × 10 22 2.9\times 10^{22} FLOPs, or 56B to 1.11T token-equivalents ( table 12 ).
We index budgets by tokens per parameter (TPP): token-equivalents divided by the backbone’s non-embedding parameters, i.e. , all parameters except the tied token embedding (1.4B at 1.7B and 3.6B at 4B; backbones are named by their total parameters).
Budgets reach 788 TPP at 1.7B and 306 TPP at 4B.
All recipes share one peak learning rate per backbone size, scaled with the inverse square root of its total parameter count ( 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} at 1.7B and 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} at 4B).
At 1.7B, the encoder’s lead over encoder-free and parity with in-fusion hold from half to twice that learning rate ( section F.2 ).

blocks.en: 2.5 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 2.5 评价

blocks.en:
We evaluate recipes on text and visual understanding benchmarks and report the following metrics. Avg. Text averages four category means over 12 language benchmarks: commonsense reasoning (COPA, HellaSwag, PIQA, Social IQa, and WinoGrande ( Roemmele et al., 2011 ; Zellers et al., 2019 ; Bisk et al., 2020 ; Sap et al., 2019 ; Sakaguchi et al., 2020 ) ), science question answering (ARC-Easy, ARC-Challenge, and OpenBookQA ( Clark et al., 2018 ; Mihaylov et al., 2018 ) ), broad knowledge (MMLU ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) ), and reading comprehension (RACE-middle, RACE-high, and BoolQ ( Lai et al., 2017 ; Clark et al., 2019 ) ). Avg. VQA averages the general, knowledge, OCR and chart, and vision-centric category means of the 16 Cambrian visual question-answering benchmarks ( Tong et al., 2024a ) , after instruction tuning each checkpoint for three epochs on Cambrian-7M with 448 × 448 448\times 448 images.
A text-only model at the same lifetime compute serves as a reference for Avg. Text ( section B.3 ). Sections 4 and 5.4 also compare held-out caption loss on images never seen in training ( section B.4 ). Appendix B details the benchmarks, and appendix I gives every benchmark score.

blocks.en: 3 Does the vision encoder need separate pretraining?
blocks.zh: 3个 视觉编码器需要单独的预训吗?

blocks.en:
The first design choice a vision encoder bundles is a visual prior imported through separate pretraining, which recent models ( Kimi Team, 2026b ) forgo by training the encoder from scratch with the language model.
Under a fixed lifetime compute budget, encoder pretraining directly competes with multimodal training for FLOPs.
Whether the prior is needed also shapes the remainder of our study, because encoder-free architectures cannot easily import one.
We test whether the prior helps by comparing encoders pretrained with different objectives against the same encoder trained from scratch with the backbone.
blocks.zh:
第一个设计选择是视觉编码器捆绑,是通过单独的预训导入的视觉先入后出,近期的模型(Kimi Team, 2026b.)通过从头开始用语言模型来训练编码器而放弃.
根据固定寿命计算预算,编码器预训直接与FLOP的多式培训相竞争.
是否需要前置也塑造了我们研究的其余部分,因为没有编码器的架构不能轻易地导入一个.
我们通过比较预训的编码器 和从头到尾训练的同一编码器 来测试前导的编码器是否有帮助

blocks.en:
We pretrain a separate encoder with each of four objectives and the same compute: contrastive image–text alignment (MetaCLIP; Xu et al., 2024 ), self-supervised learning (WebSSL; Fan et al., 2025 ), and captioning (Cap and CapPa; Tschannen et al., 2023 ).
Pretrained encoders are updated during multimodal training and compared with an encoder trained from scratch at matched lifetime compute; we also test a frozen MetaCLIP encoder.
MetaCLIP, an instance of widely used CLIP-style pretraining ( Radford et al., 2021 ; Zhai et al., 2023 ; Tschannen et al., 2025 ) , serves as the pretrained reference in the remaining experiments. Section C.1 details the pretraining objectives and section A.1 the encoder architecture.

我们预设一个单独的编码器,每个编码有四个目标和同样的计算:对比图像-文本对接(MetaCLIP;徐等,2024年),自我监督的学习(WebSSL;Fan等,2025年)和标题(Cap和CapPa;Tschannn等,2023年)。
预先培训的编码器在多式联运培训期间更新,并与在相应的寿命计算时从零开始培训的编码器进行比较;我们还测试了被冻结的MetaCLIP编码器。
MetaCLIP是广泛使用的CLIP式预训的例子(Radford等人,2021年;Zhai等人,2023年;Tschannn等人,2025年),作为其余实验中经过预训的参考. C.1节详述了预训目标和A.1节编码器架构.

blocks.en: 4 Does vision encoding need dedicated capacity?
blocks.zh: 页:1 视觉编码需要专用能力吗?

blocks.en:
The from-scratch encoder of section 3 forgoes the imported prior but keeps the second design choice: dedicated vision capacity. Encoder-free models drop this capacity entirely and project image patches directly into the shared backbone ( Adept AI, 2023 ; Diao et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Gemma Team, 2026 ; Thinking Machines
Lab, 2026a ) .
Dropping the encoder, however, also removes a substantial number of parameters and changes how raw patches enter the backbone, so a gap between the two recipes could reflect fewer total parameters, a weak patch embedding, or missing dedicated capacity.
In this section, we test whether visual understanding needs this dedicated capacity, leaving the study of its precise placement to section 5 .
blocks.zh:
第3节从scratch编码器放弃了所导入的前作,但保留了第二种设计选择:专用视觉能力. 无编码器的模型将这种容量完全下降,并直接将图像补丁投入共享主干线(Adept AI, 2023;Diao等, 2024;Liu等, 2026;Gemma Team, 2026;Winking Machines).
实验室,2026a.
然而,将编码器放下也会去掉大量参数并改变原始补丁进入主干线的方式,因此两个配方之间的缺口可以反映总参数较少,补丁嵌入能力薄弱,或者缺少专用容量.
在本节中,我们测试视觉理解是否需要这种专门能力,而将其确切位置的研究留给第5节。

blocks.en:
We compare the from-scratch encoder ( section 3 ) with the encoder-free recipe ( section 2.1 ), which maps each patch into the backbone with a linear patch embedding followed by RMSNorm and a learned gate.
As in every recipe, vision tokens attend to one another bidirectionally in the backbone ( section 2.1 ).
Both recipes share common backbones, data, and lifetime compute budgets, and we compare them at 1.7B and 4B.
blocks.zh:
我们比较了从scratch编码器(第3节)和无编码器的配方(第2.1节),它们将每个补丁都映射入主干线上,然后是RMSNorm和一个有学识的门.
与每种食谱一样,远景标志在骨干中是双向的(第2.1节)。
两种食谱都有共同的主干线,数据和终身计算预算,我们比较了1.7B和4B.

blocks.en:
Figure 3 shows that Avg. VQA clearly suffers from a missing encoder, across scales and budgets, while Avg. Text stays comparable.
This also holds when scaling the encoder’s size ( section 5.4 ).
This result differs from Shukor et al. (2025) , who find that encoder-free models match or slightly outperform encoder-based ones, mainly at smaller sizes.
We identify two choices in their setup that work against the encoder ( section D.4 ).
First, their encoder’s learning rate may have been too small.
Second, they fit their scaling laws to an average of text, interleaved, and caption losses, which drowns out the signal from vision.
In-distribution held-out caption loss instead shows the encoder-free deficit and tracks Avg. VQA across recipes, sizes, and budgets ( fig. 18 ), whereas their averaged loss hides it.

The same parameters are thus more useful as a vision encoder.

We also study replacing the encoder-free linear patch embedding with two richer ones: a normalized two-layer projection inspired by Gemma 4 ( Gemma Team, 2026 ) , and a four-layer hierarchical MLP ( Touvron et al., 2022 ) , as in Inkling ( Thinking Machines
Lab, 2026a ) .
Trained on 224 × 224 224\times 224 images, neither comes close to the encoder ( table 2 ), though the hierarchical MLP matches it when compressing 640 × 640 640\times 640 images into the same 256 tokens ( section D.3 ).
Subsequent encoder-free experiments keep the default patch embedding, so dedicated capacity is placed deliberately.

Takeaway 2: Visual understanding benefits from dedicated vision capacity. Encoder-free models trail the from-scratch encoder on Avg. VQA.

blocks.en: 5 Does dedicated capacity need to precede multimodal fusion?
blocks.zh: 页:1 是否需要专门能力在多式联运融合之前?

blocks.en:
Section 4 shows that visual understanding benefits from dedicated capacity.
We now ask whether that capacity must precede multimodal fusion.
The encoder’s parameters are both dedicated , used only by vision tokens, and pre-fusion , processing vision tokens before they interact with text.
We test whether pre-fusion placement is needed by moving the encoder’s parameter budget in-fusion, into vision-only modules inside the shared backbone ( section 5.1 ). Section 5.2 studies where this capacity should sit, which tokens should use it, and which modules it adds. Sections 5.3 and 5.4 then compare it with the encoder over training and with scale.
blocks.zh:
第4节显示,视觉理解得益于专门能力。
我们现在问,这种能力是否必须先于多式联运。
编码器的参数都是专用的,只有视觉符号使用,还有预聚,处理视觉符号后再与文字交互.
我们通过将编码器的参数预算注入到共享主干内部的只视觉模块(第5.1节)来测试是否需要进行预置。 第5.2节研究这种能力应位于何处,哪些标志应使用,以及它增加哪些模块。 然后,第5.3和5.4节与编码器在培训和规模方面进行比较。

blocks.en: 5.1 Moving the encoder’s capacity inside the backbone
blocks.zh: 5.1 将编码器的能力移入主干线

blocks.en:
In-fusion vision capacity adds vision-only modules to selected backbone layers.
In each of these layers, the attention projections and the feed-forward network (FFN) keep their shared weights and add vision-only counterparts, whose outputs add to the shared outputs after each module ( fig. 4 ).
Each vision-only module thus acts as an additive expert routed by modality: vision tokens use it alongside the shared weights.
Unlike mixture-of-transformers ( Liang et al., 2025 , MoT;) , which gives text and vision tokens entirely separate parameters, in-fusion still passes every token through the shared parameters. Section 6.2 compares the two when starting from pretrained language models.

We use two variants: “in-fusion”, our default, adds vision FFN branches of smaller hidden width and vision-only counterparts of all four attention projections, while “in-fusion (FFN-only)” adds only vision FFN branches.
We size both variants to match the encoder’s vision-only parameter budget ( table 23 ), so comparisons with the encoder vary only where dedicated capacity is placed.
Existing vision-specific architectures do not fit this comparison: they either duplicate vision weights that scale with the backbone ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Liang et al., 2025 ) or use vision adapters that rely on an encoder ( Dong et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) .

现有的视向特异性架构不符合这种比较:它们要么重复了与主干相适应的视向权重(Wang等,2024;Liang等,2025),要么使用依赖编码器的视向适配器(Dong等,2024;Wang等,2025).

blocks.en: We compare in-fusion designs that reallocate the encoder’s 0.4B vision parameters within the backbone.
blocks.zh: 我们比较在主干内部重新配置编码器0.4B视觉参数的内置设计。

blocks.en:
We study placement with the FFN-only variant, because FFN branches can be narrowed to fit any placement.
Full-rank vision-only attention projections cannot, because adding them to every layer would take 88% of the 0.4B budget at 1.7B and exceed it at 4B.
With the budget fixed, we compare four placements ( table 3 ): a narrow branch in every layer, or eight wider branches spread evenly across depth, in the last eight layers, or in the first eight layers.
The first three variants do no better than the encoder-free model on Avg. VQA, whereas placing the modules in the first eight layers matches the scratch encoder.
Early placement also helps most on OCR and chart questions, which depend on fine visual detail, whereas late placement does not.
Dedicated in-fusion capacity is therefore most useful where the backbone first processes vision tokens, similar to an encoder.
We hypothesize that vision tokens benefit most from vision-only processing while they are still close to raw patch features.
Only early placement concentrates the budget there, whereas the every-layer and spread placements dilute it across the backbone.
Layerwise representation similarity shows that the in-fusion models change vision tokens mostly within the first eight blocks, where their vision-only modules sit, and little afterward, while the encoder-free model keeps changing them through shared blocks 4–13 ( section E.4 ).
Therefore, we use the first eight layers from here on.
blocks.zh:
我们只用FFN的变体研究放置,因为FFN的分会可以被缩小以适应任何放置.
完全排位式的只注意视觉的预测是无法做到的,因为把它们加到每一层将占用0.4B预算的88%在1.7B,超过4B.
随着预算的固定,我们比较了四个布局(表3):每层都有一个狭长的分行,或者八个更宽的分行均匀地分布在纵深,后八层,或者前八层.
前三个变体并不比Avg. VQA上的无编码器模型更好,而将模块放入前八层与抓取编码器相匹配.
早期安置也最有助于OCR和图表问题,这取决于细微的视觉细节,而后期安置则无济于事.
因此,在骨干先处理视觉符号,类似于编码器的地方,专用的内注能力最有用.
我们假设,视觉符号在接近原始补丁特性时,从仅用视觉处理中受益最大。
只有早期安置才将预算集中在那里,而各级和分散安置则在骨干中冲淡。
分层表示的相似性表明,内聚物模型改变的视觉符号大多在前8个区块内,它们的视觉只模块坐在那里,之后很少,而无编码器模型则通过共享区块4–13(E.4节)不断改变.
因此,我们从这里开始使用前八层。

blocks.en:
To check that the gain comes from reserving this capacity for vision tokens, we also give the same parameters in the first eight layers to all tokens ( table 3 ).
Widening the shared FFNs barely improves over the encoder-free model.
A separate branch used by all tokens recovers some of the vision-only branch’s gain, but still trails it even with twice the training ( table 24 ).
The all-token variants slightly improve on Avg. Text, because text also uses the added parameters.
We hypothesize that a vision-only branch gives vision tokens processing of their own without competing with text for the same parameters, while both still share the backbone’s attention and FFNs.
blocks.zh:
为了检查收益是否来自将这种能力保留给视觉信使,我们还给所有信使提供了前八层相同的参数(表3)。
将共享的FFN拓宽,几乎无法改进无编码器模型.
由所有标志使用的一个单独的分支恢复了仅能见识的分支的一些收益,但即使训练了两倍(表24),它仍然追随着它.
全托克变体在Avg. Text上略有改进,因为文本也使用了所添加的参数.
我们假设,只有视觉分支在不与文本争夺相同参数的情况下,会给自己的视觉符号处理,而两者仍能分享骨干和FFN的注意力。

blocks.en: 5.3 Can in-fusion capacity match a pre-fusion encoder?
blocks.zh: 5.3 联合国 输入能力能匹配输入前的编码器吗?

blocks.en:
With the same dedicated budget on either side of the multimodal fusion boundary, we compare in-fusion with a scratch encoder at matched lifetime compute over training at 1.7B and 4B ( fig. 6 ).
In-fusion is comparable to the encoder throughout.
Like the encoder, in-fusion clearly leads encoder-free at both sizes; section 5.4 compares the recipes across backbone sizes.
Part of the in-fusion budget sits in vision-only attention projections, which help on their own in additional 4B ablations ( section E.2 ).
Dedicated vision capacity therefore does not need to precede fusion to benefit visual understanding.
In-fusion can also lower time to first token for image requests, since no encoder runs before the backbone ( section 6.3 ).

blocks.en: 5.4 Results hold with scale
blocks.zh: 5.4 具有规模的成果

blocks.en:
So far, we have compared the recipes at 1.7B and 4B with 0.4B of dedicated vision capacity.
To see how they behave with scale, we train them on a ladder of five backbone sizes from 0.6B to 6.4B (setup in appendix G ).
The dedicated vision capacity grows with the backbone, keeping its share of parameters from the 1.7B model, as in jointly scaled models ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Tian et al., 2025 ) .
For each recipe, we fit Avg. VQA, caption loss, and text loss as functions of model size N N and token-equivalents D D on all of its ladder runs.
At every size, encoder-free needs approximately three times the encoder’s compute to match it on Avg. VQA and caption loss, while in-fusion tracks the encoder ( fig. 7 ).
On text loss and Avg. Text, the three recipes are comparable ( tables 30 and 29 ).
Taken together, the findings of sections 4 and 5 hold with scale.

blocks.en: 6 Vision encoding beyond lifetime compute
blocks.zh: 6 寿命后远景编码计算

blocks.en:
Our main investigations ( sections 3 , 4 and 5 ) are deliberately controlled: they train every component from scratch and charge each stage’s compute to one lifetime budget, which enables us to isolate the three design choices of a vision encoder.
In practice, however, multimodal models are often built from separately pretrained components: a language model and, usually, a vision encoder.
Inference speed for serving also shapes these design decisions.
We find that a “free” pretrained encoder still does not help a backbone trained from scratch ( section 6.1 ), and that instead midtraining a 1.7B text-only model leaves the comparisons of sections 3 , 4 and 5 unchanged ( section 6.2 ).
Finally, in-fusion can lower the time to first token for image requests ( section 6.3 ).
blocks.zh:
我们的主要调查(第3、第4和第5节)被蓄意控制:它们从零开始训练每个部件,把每个阶段的计算费用充入一个终身预算,这使我们能够孤立一个视觉编码器的三个设计选择。
然而在实践中,多式模型往往从单独的预先训练的组件来构建:语言模型和通常的视觉编码器.
用于服务的推论速度也塑造了这些设计决定.
我们发现,“免费”预先培训的编码器仍然无助于从头开始培训的骨干(第6.1节),相反,只培训1.7B文本的模型使第3、4和5款的比较保持不变(第6.2节)。
最后,内聚能可以将时间降低到图像请求的先令(第6.3节).

blocks.en: 6.1 Zero-cost pretrained encoders
blocks.zh: 6.1 零成本预选编码器

blocks.en:
Section 3 charges encoder pretraining to the lifetime budget, but in practice a pretrained encoder is often available for free.
Here, we hold multimodal training fixed at 2.7 × 10 21 2.7\times 10^{21} FLOPs and vary MetaCLIP pretraining from 1.4 × 10 21 1.4\times 10^{21} to 9.0 × 10 21 9.0\times 10^{21} FLOPs.
This raises the encoder’s ImageNet linear-probe accuracy before multimodal training from 80.4% to 84.4% ( fig. 9 ; section C.3 ), yet Avg. VQA is highest after the shortest pretraining, and an encoder trained from scratch with the same multimodal training matches it.
Thus, even when pretraining is free, more of it does not help.

这使得编码器的ImageNet线性测试精度在多式联运训练前从80.4%提高到84.4%(图. 9; C.3 节),然而Avg. VQA在经过最短的预训后最高,并且从头开始训练的编码器与同样的多式训练相匹配.
因此,即使预训是免费的,更多的预训也无济于事。

blocks.en: 6.2 Midtraining from pretrained language models
blocks.zh: 6.2 预训语言模式的中训

blocks.en:
Many multimodal models add vision to a language model pretrained on text alone ( Alayrac et al., 2022 ; Liu et al., 2023 ; Tong et al., 2024a ; Bai et al., 2025a ) .
We call this stage of continued training on multimodal data midtraining .
We test whether the comparisons of sections 3 , 4 and 5 hold in this setting.
We pretrain our own 1.7B language model on 1T tokens of the same text data and then midtrain it to 1.33T token-equivalents with each recipe at equal compute ( fig. 9 ).
Following DeepSeek-VL ( Lu et al., 2024a ) , midtraining keeps 70% text data; as in section 6.1 , MetaCLIP’s encoder pretraining is not counted.
Besides the four recipes, we compare MoT ( section 5.1 , initialized from the language model) and a variant that copies only its first eight layers, matching the encoder’s 0.4B vision-only parameters.

blocks.en:
In-fusion, MoT layers 1–8, and the from-scratch encoder perform comparably, and all lead encoder-free.
The full MoT model falls behind despite 3.5 times as many vision-only parameters—adding vision-only copies of the later layers to MoT layers 1–8 hurts, consistent with late placement not helping in section 5.2 .
A free MetaCLIP encoder, which matches the from-scratch encoder when the backbone is also trained from scratch ( section 6.1 ), trails it here, mostly on OCR, chart, and vision-centric questions.
Tuning each encoder’s learning rate does not change these conclusions ( section H.1 ).
We hypothesize that the from-scratch encoder learns features suited to the pretrained language model from its first update, whereas MetaCLIP’s contrastive features, which miss fine visual detail ( Tong et al., 2024b ) , must be reshaped by a language model that already leans on text.
Every recipe keeps Avg. Text within a point of a text-only control.
Thus, the conclusions from our controlled experiments ( sections 3 , 4 and 5 ) carry over to midtraining, where a free pretrained encoder trails the from-scratch encoder, encoder-free trails on VQA, and in-fusion is comparable to the pre-fusion encoder.

blocks.en: 6.3 Training and inference speed
blocks.zh: 6.3 训练和推断速度

blocks.en: Figure 10: In-fusion serves images faster than the encoder at every vision parameter budget. Designs are parameter-matched on the 1.7B backbone.

blocks.en:
A separate encoder must finish processing each image before the backbone can start, which adds a serial step to inference.
Following the inference benchmark of Mono-InternVL ( Luo et al., 2025b ) , we measure time to first token (TTFT) on one H200 with 16 concurrent requests, each with one 448-pixel image and 256 text tokens ( section H.3 ).
At 1.7B with 0.4B vision-only parameters, in-fusion and its FFN-only variant are clearly faster than the encoder ( fig. 10 ) at comparable Avg. VQA
( table 26 ).
MoT, which copies the first k k backbone layers for vision tokens, is about as fast as in-fusion up to 0.4B vision-only parameters, but its added TTFT grows faster with the budget, while staying below the encoder’s TTFT.
Encoder-free is fastest but clearly trails on Avg. VQA ( table 26 ).
In-fusion’s TTFT advantage over the encoder grows with the vision-only budget ( fig. 10 ), which scales with the backbone ( section 5.4 ); at a fixed budget, vision adds nearly the same time at 1.7B and 4B ( table 36 ).
Earlier encoder-free models report larger TTFT reductions, up to 69% ( Luo et al., 2025b ; Luo et al., 2025a ) , although their gains also reflect other efficiency changes.
Inference benefits also depend on deployment details.
Under continuous batching of mixed text and image requests, in-fusion’s vision-only modules run in the same forward passes as text-only requests, whereas a separate encoder adds latency only to image requests.
Finally, both in-fusion variants train as fast as encoder-free, whereas the encoder recipe is 3% slower at 4B ( table 35 ).

blocks.en: 7 Related work
blocks.zh: 7 相关工作

blocks.en:
Most multimodal models connect a separately pretrained vision encoder ( Radford et al., 2021 ; Tschannen et al., 2025 ; Bolya et al., 2025 ) , kept frozen ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2023b ; Muse Glimmer Team, 2026 ) or updated ( Beyer et al., 2024 ; Steiner et al., 2024 ; Bai et al., 2025a ) , to a pretrained language model.
More recent models train the encoder from scratch with the language model ( Kimi Team, 2026b ; Tian et al., 2025 ) , embed image patches without an encoder ( Adept AI, 2023 ; Diao et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Gemma Team, 2026 ; Thinking Machines
Lab, 2026a ) , or quantize images with a separately trained tokenizer ( Chameleon Team, 2024 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) .
Inkling was released as “encoder-free”, yet its successor, Inkling 2 Small, uses a 292M-parameter vision encoder ( Thinking Machines
Lab, 2026a ; Thinking Machines
Lab, 2026b ) .
Because these models also differ in data, pretrained components, and compute, comparing them directly does not isolate a single design choice.
We therefore train every stage of each recipe class from scratch on common data sources and compare the recipes at matched lifetime compute ( section 2 ).

因此,我们从零开始在共同数据来源上培训每一类食谱的每一个阶段,并在相应的寿命计算时比较食谱(第2节)。

blocks.en:
Prior controlled studies of encoder pretraining typically start from a pretrained language model, count only multimodal training, and compare encoder pretraining objectives and data ( Karamcheti et al., 2024 ; McKinzie et al., 2024 ; Tong et al., 2024a ; Laurençon et al., 2024 ; Fan et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ) rather than studying whether separate pretraining is needed at all.
The few works that compare pretrained and from-scratch encoders vary in their findings, possibly because they control neither the encoder’s pretraining data nor lifetime compute ( Tian et al., 2025 ; Kimi Team, 2026b ) .
Studies raise a similar question for language pretraining, finding that adding vision before text-only pretraining ends, rather than after it, improves visual understanding ( Keh et al., 2025 ; Han et al., 2026 ; Kimi Team, 2026a ) , as in our delayed-vision experiments ( table 11 ).
Encoder pretraining also confounds encoder vs. encoder-free comparisons, which typically pit a pretrained encoder against an encoder-free model ( Beyer et al., 2024 ; Diao et al., 2024 ; Lei et al., 2025 ; Diao et al., 2025 ; Tong et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) .
Such comparisons remove separate pretraining, dedicated capacity, and pre-fusion placement at once, and often attribute the encoder’s advantage to pretraining data they do not control. Shukor et al. (2025) , who train both designs from scratch, find that encoder-free models match or slightly outperform an encoder.
In contrast, we find that the encoder leads on VQA and held-out caption loss, which we trace to their setup ( section D.4 ).
blocks.zh:
事先控制的编码器预训研究一般从预训语言模型入手,只计算多式训练,并比较编码器预训目标和数据(Karamcheti等,2024;McKinzie等,2024;Tong等,2024a;Laurençon等,2024;Fan等,2025;Li等,2025),而不是研究是否需要单独的预训.
比较预训和分解编码器的少数作品在发现上各有不同,可能因为它们既不控制编码器的预训数据,也不控制寿命计算(Tian等,2025;Kimi Team,2026b).
研究提出了语言预训的类似问题,发现在仅文本预训结束之前,而不是之后,添加视觉会提高视觉理解(Keh等,2025;Han等,2026;Kimi Team,2026a),如我们的延迟视觉实验(表11).
编码器预试也混淆了编码器与无编码器的比较,这种比较通常会比照无编码器的模型(Beyer等人,2024年;Diao等人,2024年;Lei等人,2025年;Diao等人,2025年;Tong等人,2026年;Liu等人,2026年;Chen等人,2026年)。
这种比较会同时去除单独的预训,专用容量,以及预置位置,并常常将编码器的优势归结为预训数据它们无法控制. Shukor等人(2025年)从零开始对两种设计进行训练,他们发现无编码器的模型匹配或略胜于一个编码器.
相比之下,我们发现编码器导致VQA和被搁置的字幕丢失,我们追踪到他们的设置(D.4节)。

blocks.en:
Testing whether dedicated capacity must precede fusion requires moving the encoder’s capacity inside the backbone, which the encoder vs. encoder-free comparisons cannot accomplish.
Prior works on fusion depth come closer, varying where modalities begin to interact ( Nagrani et al., 2021 ; Hao et al., 2026 ) or where encoder features enter the backbone ( Meng et al., 2024 ) , but none moves a fixed amount of vision-only capacity into layers that vision and text share.
Other multimodal architectures add vision-specific parameters to the backbone, but not in a form that fits this comparison.
Modality-expert designs duplicate the backbone’s weights for vision tokens, typically in every layer, and route vision tokens through these copies instead of the shared weights ( Bao et al., 2022 ; Lin et al., 2024 ; Liang et al., 2025 ) .
Their vision-only capacity is thus set by the backbone’s size and spread over its depth rather than held at an encoder’s budget early in the model, and most also build on a pretrained language model ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Luo et al., 2025b ; Tian et al., 2025 ; Diao et al., 2025 ; Shi et al., 2025 ) .
Adapter architectures fine-tune a pretrained model through small parallel or low-rank modules shared by all tokens ( He et al., 2022 ; Chen et al., 2022 ; Hu et al., 2022 ) , and their multimodal variants keep an encoder alongside the adapters ( Dong et al., 2024 ; Shapourian et al., 2026 ) or distill from one ( Wang et al., 2025 ) .
The encoders in these works still supply pre-fusion capacity or a pretrained prior, the two factors our comparison aims to remove.
We instead give vision tokens their own attention projections and feed-forward branches in selected backbone layers.
Their outputs add to the shared ones and together match an encoder’s parameter budget, so only the placement of this capacity changes ( section 5 ).
Placed in the first eight layers, in-fusion capacity is comparable to a pre-fusion encoder on VQA, so dedicated vision capacity helps whether it sits pre-fusion or in-fusion.
blocks.zh:

之前关于聚变深度的作品越来越接近,在模式开始相互作用(Nagrani等,2021;Hao等,2026)或编码器特征进入骨干时(Meng等,2024),但无一能将固定数量的仅能视觉的能力移动到视觉和文本共享的地层.
其他多式建筑在骨干上添加了与愿景相适应的参数,但并不以适合这种比较的形式.
Modality-expert design 复制了主干对视觉符号的权重,一般在每一层,路由视觉符号通过这些拷贝而不是共享权重(Bao等,2022;Lin等,2024;Liang等,2025).
因此,其仅能见识的能力是由骨干的规模决定的,并且分散在它的深度,而不是在模型早期由编码器预算来维持,大多数还建立在预先训练的语言模型之上(Wang等,2024;Luo等,2025b; Tian等,2025;Diao等,2025;Shi等,2025;).

其产出增加了共享的产出,合在一起与编码器的参数预算相匹配,因此只有这种容量变化的位置(第5款).
被放入前八层,内聚能可与VQA上的预聚能编码器相媲美,因此专用的视觉能有助于它是否坐入预聚能或内聚能.

blocks.en: 8 Discussion
blocks.zh: 8 讨论情况

blocks.en:
With multimodal models revisiting the vision encoder, we asked which of its design choices are still beneficial.
We proposed unbundling the encoder into three choices: a visual prior from separate pretraining, dedicated vision capacity, and pre-fusion placement of that capacity.
We tested each by training every recipe from scratch on common data, with one architecture and optimization setup, and comparing recipes on text and visual understanding benchmarks at matched lifetime compute.
blocks.zh:
随着多模式模式重新审视了视觉编码器,我们问其哪些设计选择仍然有益。
我们提议将编码器分解为三个选择:一个先于单独的预训的视觉,专用的视觉能力,以及这种能力的预置。
我们从头到尾地对每个食谱进行共同数据培训, 并用一个架构和优化设置,

blocks.en:
Of the three choices an encoder bundles, only dedicated vision capacity maintains its advantage.
Separate pretraining is unnecessary: an encoder trained jointly with the backbone is on par with pretrained ones, and longer pretraining improves recognition but not VQA, even when it is free ( sections 3 and 6.1 ).
Dedicated capacity matters: with the encoder’s parameters added to their shared backbone, encoder-free models gain on Avg. Text but still trail the encoder on Avg. VQA ( section 4 ), most on OCR and chart questions ( table 2 ).
This capacity belongs early, but it need not precede the backbone: vision-only modules in the first backbone layers are comparable to a pre-fusion encoder ( section 5 ).
For recipes that drop the encoder, this suggests reallocating its parameters as vision-only capacity in the earliest layers rather than as shared parameters.
blocks.zh:
在三种选择中,一个编码器捆绑,只有专用的视觉能力保持其优势.
单独的预训是不必要的:与骨干共同培训的编码器与被预训的编码器是等同的,较长的预训可以提高识别,但不能提高VQA,即使免费(第3和6.1节.).
专用能力问题:随着编码器的参数被添加到其共享的骨干上,Avg上的无编码器模型增益. Avg. VQA(第4节)上的文本仍然跟踪编码器,大部分内容是OCR和图表问题(表2).
这种容量属于早期,但不需要先于主干:第一个主干层中仅可视的模块可与预聚能编码器(第5节.
对于掉入编码器的食谱,这建议将其参数重新定位为最早的地层中仅可视的能力,而不是共享的参数.

blocks.en:
To keep comparisons controlled, we pretrain encoders on the same images as multimodal training, so our results do not rule out a benefit from released encoders trained on additional data.
Encoder pretraining uses the images’ original alt-text, as in standard image–text pretraining; pretraining on our regenerated captions instead changes little ( table 9 ).
Our experiments are on dense backbones with up to 6.4B parameters; the most compelling next step is extending them to sparse mixture-of-experts backbones, whose experts could naturally host in-fusion’s modality-routed capacity.
Multimodal training also uses 224 × 224 224\times 224 MetaCLIP images, leaving higher-resolution training and more text-rich data to future work.
The text–image data mixture was selected with the from-scratch encoder at 1.7B, so mixtures tuned for each recipe remain underexplored ( section A.4 ).
Finally, how architecture interacts with interleaved image–text and video data remains open.
blocks.zh:
为了控制比较,我们预先对编码器进行与多式联运培训相同的图像培训,因此,我们的结果不排除对发布编码器进行额外数据培训的好处。
Encoder 预训使用图像的原始备选案文, 如标准图像的文本预训; 关于我们再生成的标题的预训则变化不大(表9) 。
我们的实验是在密度可达6.4B参数的骨干上;最有说服力的下一步是将它们扩展至稀少的混合专家骨干上,他们的专家自然可以容纳内聚能模式化的能力。
多式联运培训还使用了224×224/224\times 224 MetaCLIP图像,将更高分辨率的培训和更多的文本丰富的数据留给了未来的工作.
文本-图像数据混合物在1.7B处与从scratch编码器相选取,因此对每种食谱的混合物的调制仍然未得到充分探讨(A.4节)。
最后,架构如何与互开的图像互动-文本和视频数据仍然开放。

blocks.en:
We presented a controlled study that disentangles the design choices behind how multimodal models process visual input, studying each choice in isolation instead of as part of a bundled recipe.
Rather than assembling multimodal models from components optimized for different objectives, our findings favor training them end-to-end as one system.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了一个有控制的研究,它将设计选择与多式联运模型如何处理视觉输入的方法分开,孤立地研究每个选择,而不是作为捆绑的食谱的一部分。
我们的研究结果不是从为不同目标而优化的组件中汇集多式联运模式,而是倾向于将它们训练成一个系统。

blocks.en: A.1 Architectures
blocks.zh: A.1 建筑

blocks.en:
The multimodal recipes differ in where their vision-only capacity sits and how it is trained: in a pre-fusion vision encoder that is pretrained and then frozen or updated, or trained from scratch, encoder-free with no module besides a patch embedding, or vision-only modules inside the shared backbone (in-fusion vision capacity; section E.1 ).
Unless a variable is the stated ablation, comparisons hold the backbone, the 256 vision tokens per image in multimodal training, the data, the optimization recipe, and lifetime compute fixed. Table 4 lists the backbone and encoder architectures.
blocks.zh:
多式联运配方在仅以视觉为主的容量位置和如何培训方面各不相同:在预先培训、然后被冷冻或更新或从头培训的预聚变相能编码器中,除嵌入补丁外没有模块的编码器是无编码的,或者在共享主干内有只以视觉为主的模块(注入变相能;E.1节)。
除非一个变量是所说明的衰减,否则比较将保持主干,在多模式训练中每个图像的256个视觉符号,数据,优化配方,以及寿命计算固定. 表4列出了骨干和编码器架构.

blocks.en:
The shared backbone is a dense decoder-only Transformer that follows the Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-4B configurations ( Yang et al., 2025 ) and is trained from random initialization.
Its FFNs use SwiGLU ( Shazeer, 2020 ) , and its attention uses grouped key–value heads with RMSNorm on queries and keys.
The vision-only FFN branches of in-fusion vision capacity use the same form and read the same normalized input as the shared FFN ( section E.1 ).

共享骨干是一款密集的解码器唯一的变形器,它遵循了Qune3–1.7B和Qune3–4B的配置(Yang等,2025年),通过随机初始化进行训练.
其FFN使用SwiGLU(Shazeer,2020年),其关注使用分组键-在查询和键上使用RMSNorm值头.
内聚能中仅能视的FFN分支使用与共享的FFN相同的形式并读取相同的常态输入(E.1节.

During multimodal training, each image is resized bilinearly to a shorter side of 224 pixels, center-cropped to 224 × 224 224\times 224 , and divided into 14 × 14 14\times 14 patches, producing 256 vision tokens.

We chose the from-scratch encoder’s shape and size at matched lifetime compute, and every main comparison uses the resulting 27-layer, 0.4B encoder.
The shape and size comparisons use the 1.7B backbone at 2.6 × 10 21 2.6\times 10^{21} FLOPs ( table 5 ).

The configurations in table 5 vary the structure of the dedicated visual computation.
Half-Depth, Wide, and Shallow + Wide are pre-fusion encoders that change the default encoder’s depth, width, or both.
The backbone-style encoder is also a pre-fusion encoder.
It has its own patch embedding and eight Transformer blocks shaped like those of the 1.7B backbone, and it connects to the backbone through the linear projection of eq. 4 .
The Default, Shallow + Wide, and backbone-style variants use about the same vision-only parameter budget; the Half-Depth and Wide variants test smaller and larger budgets, respectively.
The “Size” section of table 5 scales the default encoder’s depth and width together, from Small (0.05B) to Huge (0.92B).

blocks.en: A.3 Optimization settings
blocks.zh: A.3 优化设置

blocks.en:
Table 8 lists the optimization settings for multimodal training and instruction tuning.
We train the Transformer weight matrices with Muon ( Jordan et al., 2024 ) , applied per head to the query, key, and value projections ( Kimi Team, 2026b ) , and the embeddings, output heads, normalization parameters, and biases with AdamW.
The peak learning rate scales with the inverse square root of the backbone’s total parameter count, and training follows a warmup–stable–decay schedule ( Hu et al., 2024 ; Wen et al., 2025 ; Hägele et al., 2024 ) .
Checkpoints taken before the final decay use a constant learning rate.
The decay lowers the learning rate linearly to 5% of its peak over the last 10% of updates, so a run whose stable phase ends at compute C C finishes at C / 0.9 C/0.9 (for example, 1.17 × 10 22 1.17\times 10^{22} and 1.30 × 10 22 1.30\times 10^{22} FLOPs at 1.7B and 2.61 × 10 22 2.61\times 10^{22} and 2.90 × 10 22 2.90\times 10^{22} FLOPs at 4B; table 12 ).

表8列出了多式联运培训和教学调试的优化设置。
我们用Muon(Jordan等, 2024年)来训练变形器重量矩阵, 将每个头应用到查询、关键和价值预测(Kimi Team, 2026b),
峰值学习速率的尺度是主干总参数的倒方根数,培训遵循了暖-平-去克时间表(Hu等,2024;Wen等,2025;Hägelle等,2024)。
最终衰变前的检查点使用恒定的学习率.
在最后10%的更新中,衰变将学习率线性降低到峰值的5%,因此在计算C时稳定相结束于C/0.9 C/0.9的C/0.9(例如,1.17×10 22 1.17\tims 10^{22}和1.30×10 22 1.30\tims 10^{22}FLOPs在1.7B和2.61×10 22 2.61\tims 10^{22}和2.90×10 22 2.90\tims 10^{22}FLOPs在4B;表12)。

blocks.en: A.4 Training data and mixture
blocks.zh: A.4 培训数据和混合物

blocks.en:
Text-only sequences come from Nemotron-CC v2 ( NVIDIA, 2025b ) and v2.1 ( NVIDIA, 2025a ) , and image–text sequences use MetaCLIP 1.2 image–text pairs (English subset) ( Xu et al., 2024 ) .
Every training sequence has 4,096 tokens and packs several documents.
Attention is bidirectional among the vision tokens of each image and causal otherwise.
It stays within each document in image–text sequences and in every sequence of the text-only reference, whereas the text sequences of image-trained models attend across packed documents.
Multimodal training uses a 70:30 mixture of text and image–text sequences, which we select below ( table 10 ).
Each image is processed at 224 × 224 224\times 224 resolution and yields 256 vision tokens ( section A.1 ).
An image–text sequence packs about 12.8 MetaCLIP 1.2 pairs, each one image and its caption, so vision tokens fill about 80% of an image–text sequence and, under the 70:30 mixture, about 24% of all training tokens.
Below, the data ablation varies the mixture and the study of when image–text data enters training uses a 90:10 mixture; the richer patch embeddings of section D.3 read higher-resolution images.

每个训练序列都有4,096个令牌,并装有多份文件.

To ablate the choice of regenerated captions versus alt-text, we pretrain the CapPa encoder for 7.7 × 10 20 7.7\times 10^{20} FLOPs on either the alt-text or our regenerated captions and train it with the 1B ladder backbone ( table 28 ), a 0.4B encoder, and the 70:30 mixture, against the from-scratch encoder, to 32 and 64 tokens per parameter ( table 9 ).
The regenerated-caption encoder scores slightly higher Avg. VQA than the alt-text encoder and matches the from-scratch encoder.

blocks.en:
We select the 70:30 mixture of text and image–text sequences by an ablation on the 1.7B backbone with a from-scratch vision encoder, consistent with controlled studies of data balance in early multimodal training ( Han et al., 2026 ) .
At the same lifetime compute ( 2.34 × 10 21 2.34\times 10^{21} FLOPs, at a constant learning rate), we compare it with 100:0, 90:10, and 50:50 mixtures ( table 10 ).
The 70:30 mixture gives the best Avg. VQA with slight degradation to text, whereas 90:10 keeps Avg. Text closer to the text-only model.

blocks.en:
We also vary the point in training at which image–text data enters.
Every schedule allocates 10% of lifetime training examples to image–text data, a 90:10 mixture rather than the constant 70:30 mixture above.
We compare schedules that begin image–text training at different points while keeping the total number of image–text examples and lifetime compute fixed ( fig. 11 ).
Later schedules continue the language model and optimizer, add a randomly initialized vision encoder and projector, and warm up the new parameters for 4,000 updates.
Starting image–text training at the first update gives the strongest visual understanding.
Starting at 25%, 50%, or 75% of training lowers Avg. VQA, with the largest drops on general and on OCR and chart questions, while Avg. Text stays comparable ( table 11 ).
blocks.zh:
我们也会在培训中更改图像文本数据输入的时间。
每个时间表将一生中10%的训练实例分配给图像文本数据,一个90:10的混合物,而不是上面的常数70:30的混合物。
我们比较开始图像-文本培训在不同点的进度表,同时保持图像-文本实例和寿命计算总数固定(图11)。

blocks.en: A.5 Compute accounting
blocks.zh: A.5 计算会计

blocks.en:
Lifetime compute ( eq. 1 ) sums the training compute of every stage that produces the final model: multimodal training for every recipe, encoder pretraining for pretrained encoders, and, in midtraining ( section 6.2 ), the text-only pretraining of the language model.
As with fine-tuning in transfer evaluation, instruction tuning is a fixed downstream step applied to every checkpoint to measure VQA ( appendix B ), so it is not counted.
Each term uses the same algorithmic count of forward- and backward-pass matrix multiplication and convolution FLOPs for the modules active in that stage ( Kaplan et al., 2020 ; Hoffmann et al., 2022 ) .
The count excludes activation recomputation ( Chowdhery et al., 2023 ) , optimizer updates, communication, elementwise operations, and input processing.
A frozen encoder receives no backward pass during multimodal training, so it is charged only its forward pass, one third of its training cost.
The free-encoder comparison of section 6.1 instead matches multimodal training compute and does not charge encoder pretraining.
blocks.zh:
寿命计算(eq. 1)将产生最终模式的每个阶段的培训计算为:每种食谱的多模式培训,预训编码器的编码预训,以及在中训(第6.2节)中,语言模式的文本只预训.
与转移评价的微调一样,指令调取是适用于每个检查站的固定下游步骤,用于测量VQA(附录B),因此不计算.
每个名词对活跃在该阶段的模块使用相同的前向和后向通基质乘法和演化FLOP的算法计数(Kaplan等,2020;Hoffmann等,2022).
计数不包括活化再计算(Chowdhery等,2023年),优化更新,通信,元素操作,以及输入处理.
被冻结的编码器在多式培训期间没有获得后向通行证,因此只收取其前向通行证,即培训费用的三分之一.
第6.1节的自由编码器的比较则与多式联运培训相匹配,不收取编码器预培训费。

blocks.en:
A pretrained encoder is charged the full compute of its upstream training up to the checkpoint used.
Because a MetaCLIP example costs less compute than a captioning example, the same upstream compute buys MetaCLIP about 12% more epochs.
The objective comparisons hold upstream compute equal across objectives, so they use MetaCLIP checkpoints matched to the compute of 1, 2, 4, and 8 captioning epochs ( section C.1 ).
The sweep of section C.3 compares MetaCLIP only with itself, so it uses MetaCLIP’s own 2-, 4-, 8-, and 13-epoch checkpoints.
blocks.zh:
事先经过训练的编码器要按其上游训练的全部计算,直至使用的检查站。
因为一个MetaCLIP实例的计算成本比一个标题示例要低,所以同样的上游计算购买MetaCLIP大约多出12%的时间.
客观比较使上游计算各目标相等,因此它们使用MetaCLIP检查站,与1、2、4和8个标题时代计算相符(C.1节)。
C.3节的扫荡只比较MetaCLIP本身,因此它使用MetaCLIP自己的2-,4-,8-和13-划时代的检查站.

blocks.en:
To provide intuition about compute scales, we also express each budget in token-equivalents , the number of tokens that a text-only model of the same backbone size would train on with the same compute: H eq = C lifetime c LM , H_{\mathrm{eq}}=\frac{C_{\mathrm{lifetime}}}{c_{\mathrm{LM}}}, (6) where c LM c_{\mathrm{LM}} is that text-only model’s training FLOPs per token, 1.17 × 10 10 1.17\times 10^{10} at 1.7B and 2.61 × 10 10 2.61\times 10^{10} at 4B.
For example, a budget of 200B token-equivalents is 2.34 × 10 21 2.34\times 10^{21} FLOPs at 1.7B, and table 12 gives every decayed budget in FLOPs and tokens per parameter; a constant-learning-rate checkpoint sits at 0.9 times its decayed budget ( section A.3 ).

为了提供计算尺度的直觉,我们也以等同的符号来表达每个预算, 相同主干大小的文本专用模型会用同样的计算来训练的符号数量: H eq = C life c LM, H_{\mathrm{eq}}=\frac{ C_{\mathrm{ lifetime}克_{\mathrm{LM}}}, (6) C LM c_{\-mathrm{LM}}-是该文本模式的训练FLOPs / airs, 1.17×10 10 1.17\tims 10^{-10}在1.7B和 2.61×10 2.61\tims 10^{-10}4B.
例如,200B等同物的预算为2.34×10 21 2.34\times 10^{21}FLOP为1.7B,表12给出了每个参数中FLOP和等同物的每一份衰减预算;一个常学习率的检查站是其衰减预算的0.9倍(A.3节)。

blocks.en: Table 12: Compute budgets can be expressed as token-equivalents, FLOPs, or TPP. TPP divides by each backbone’s non-embedding parameter count.
blocks.zh: 表12:计算预算可以表示为符号等值,FLOP或TPP. TPP 将每个主干线的非嵌入参数计数除以.

blocks.en:
Architecture and data mixture change the number of updates at fixed compute.
For instance, at 2.34 × 10 21 2.34\times 10^{21} FLOPs, the 1.7B text-only model takes 47.7K updates of 1,024 × 4,096 1{,}024\times 4{,}096 tokens (200B tokens), and the from-scratch encoder recipe with the 70:30 mixture takes 45.3K, because the encoder’s computation also counts toward the budget.
blocks.zh:
结构和数据混合物在固定计算时改变更新次数.
例如,在2.34 × 10 21 2.34\times 10\\\21}FLOPs时,1.7B文本专用模式需要47.7K 更新 1,024 × 4 096 1{,}024\times 4{,}096 令牌(200B令牌),而用70:30混合的从scratch编码器配方需要45.3K,因为编码器的计算也算在预算上。

blocks.en: Appendix B Evaluation
blocks.zh: 附录B 评价

blocks.en:
This section describes the two main evaluation metrics, Avg. VQA and Avg. Text.
We also define the held-out losses that sections 4 , 5.4 and F.3 use as well as two additional metrics, out-of-distribution caption loss and ImageNet linear-probe accuracy.
blocks.zh:
本节介绍两项主要评价衡量标准:Avg. VQA和Avg. Text.
我们还界定了第4、5.4和F.3节所使用的搁置损失以及另外两个指标,即分配外标题损失和ImageNet线性测试准确性。

blocks.en: B.1 VQA benchmarks
blocks.zh: B.1 自愿质量评估基准

blocks.en:
We use instruction tuning as an evaluation protocol ( Tong et al., 2024a ) .
Every multimodal model checkpoint is instruction-tuned with one fixed recipe before we measure its visual understanding.
The recipe runs three epochs of Cambrian-7M ( Tong et al., 2024a ) before evaluation.
Multimodal training reads 224 × 224 224\times 224 images, but instruction tuning and evaluation raise the resolution to 448 × 448 448\times 448 (1,024 vision tokens), since OCR and chart reading needs fine detail ( Tong et al., 2024a ; Beyer, 2024 ) .
Exhibits whose captions say so instead retain the multimodal-training resolution of 224 × 224 224\times 224 (256 vision tokens), otherwise with the same recipe.
The encoder’s learned position table is interpolated to the larger patch grid, and the fixed sine–cosine positions of encoder-free and in-fusion models are recomputed for it.
Cambrian-7M is a curated instruction-tuning mixture spanning general visual tasks, OCR and charts, counting, math, science, code, and language-only data. Table 8 provides the optimizer settings and batch size.
Instruction tuning updates the same parameters as multimodal training.
Therefore, a frozen encoder, e.g., the frozen MetaCLIP encoder in table 16 , stays frozen.
blocks.zh:
我们使用指令调试作为评估协议(Tong等人,2024a.) 。 。 。 。
每一个多模式检查点,在我们衡量其视觉理解之前,都用一个固定的食谱来进行指示调整。
食谱在评价前为Cambrian-7M(Tong等,2024a.)三个纪元.
多式联运训练读取了224×224 2.24\times 224图像,但指令调取和评价将分辨率提高到了448×448 448\times 448 (1,024个视觉符号),因为OCR和图表读取需要细微的细节(Tong等,2024a;Beyer,2024).
其标题如此描述的展览则保留了224×224/224\times 224(256个视觉符号)的多式培训分辨率,否则使用相同的配方。
编码器的学习位置表被插到更大的补丁网格上,而固定的无编码器和内聚物模型的正弦正弦位置被重新计算出来.
Cambrian-7M是一款可解析的指令调取混合物,涵盖一般的视觉任务,OCR和图表,计数,数学,科学,代码,以及只使用语言的数据. 表8提供了优化器设置和批量大小.
指令调整更新了与多式联运培训相同的参数。
因此,一个被冻结的编码器,例如表16中被冻结的MetaCLIP编码器,仍然被冻结。

blocks.en:
Evaluation follows the Cambrian-1 visual understanding suite ( Tong et al., 2024a ) , using greedy decoding with at most 256 output tokens.
Each task is capped at its first 5,000 examples in dataset order. Table 13 lists the 16 benchmarks in four categories (general, knowledge, OCR and chart, and vision-centric), with the split, metric, and number of examples for each.
Exact match compares the normalized parsed answer or option letter with the reference answers, relaxed accuracy tolerates small numeric errors, and VQA accuracy is the consensus metric ( Antol et al., 2015 ) that TextVQA uses.
Each category mean averages its four benchmarks.
The suite contains 15 benchmarks scored in [ 0,100 ] [0,100] and MME-Perception (MME-P), whose ten subtasks each score out of 200.
We divide the MME-P total by 20 to put it on the same scale, and Avg. VQA is the mean of the 16 scores, which equals the mean of the four category means.
blocks.zh:
评价遵循了Cambrian-1视觉理解套件(Tong等,2024a.),使用贪婪的解码,最多可使用256个出品符.
按数据集顺序,每个任务在头5000个实例上被封顶. 表13列出了16个基准,分为4个类别(一般、知识、OCR和图表、以愿景为中心的),其中每个类别有划分、衡量和实例数量。
精确匹配将归一解析后的答复或选项字母与参考答案进行比较,放松精度能容忍小的数字错误,而VQA精度是TextVQA使用的共识度量衡(Antol等,2015年).
每个类别均指四个基准。
该套装包含以[0,100] [0,100]和MME-Perception(MME-P)中得分的15个基准,其10个子任务各得分200分.
将MME-P总分除以20来同平分,而Avg. VQA是16分的平分,等于4个类别的平分.

blocks.en:
Table 13: Avg. VQA weights four categories of visual understanding benchmarks, Each category contains four tasks.
MME-P is normalized to [ 0,100 ] [0,100] before averaging.
Examples counts the questions evaluated.
blocks.zh:
表13: Avg. VQA加权四类视觉理解基准,每类包含四个任务.
MME-P在平均值前正常化为 [0,100][0,100].
所评价的问题就是例子。

blocks.en:
The blank-image control separates visual understanding from what the question alone supports.
It replaces every image with zeros during both instruction tuning and evaluation while keeping the vision-token positions.
We use it only for the text-only (100:0) row of the data-mixture ablation ( table 10 ), which has no trained visual pathway.
At 1.7B, this row reaches 28 Avg. VQA, a measure of how much the questions alone support ( Goyal et al., 2017 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Brown et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
空白图像控制将视觉理解与问题本身所支持的内容区分开来.
它在指令调制和评价期间,用零来取代每个图像,同时保持视距位置。
我们只用于文本行(100:0)的数据混合断层(表10),没有经过训练的视觉路径。
在1.7B时,这行达到28 Avg. VQA,这是衡量问题本身支持多少的尺度(Goyal等,2017;Chen等,2024;Brown等,2026.).

blocks.en: B.2 Language benchmarks
blocks.zh: B.2 语文基准

blocks.en:
Language evaluations use the multimodal checkpoint without instruction tuning. Table 14 lists the 12 benchmarks, their categories, and how each is scored.
All tasks rank the answer choices by log-likelihood; MMLU uses five subject-matched demonstrations and averages its 57 subjects equally, and the other tasks are zero-shot.
Avg. Text is the mean of the four category scores, each the mean of its benchmarks, with ARC-Easy and ARC-Challenge averaged into one ARC score and RACE-middle and RACE-high combined by test-question count.
blocks.zh:
语言评价使用多模式检查点,不进行指令调试. 表14列出了12个基准、其类别以及每个基准的得分。
所有任务都以对数相似的方式排序答案选择;MMLU使用五个主题相匹配的演示并平均其57个主题,其他任务为零镜头.
Avg. Text是4个类别分数的平均值,每分基准的平均值,ARC-Easy和ARC-Challenge均分为1个ARC分数,RACE-middle和RACE-高分由试题计数相加.

blocks.en: Table 14: Avg. Text averages four categories of text benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 表14:Avg. 文本平均为四类文本基准.

blocks.en: B.3 Text-only reference
blocks.zh: B.3 仅提及文本

blocks.en:
At the same text-token budget, the multimodal recipes score about as well on Avg. Text as a text-only reference trained on the same text: on average 0.1 point below it at 1.7B and 0.6 below at 4B ( fig. 12 ).
The encoder, encoder-free, and in-fusion recipes behave alike.
At matched lifetime compute, the reference leads by 0.5 to 3.9 points ( table 27 ), because multimodal training gives 30% of its sequences to image–text data and so sees about 30% fewer text tokens.
Vision therefore costs text little beyond the text data it displaces.
blocks.zh:
在相同的文本库预算中,多式配方在Avg也得分。 文本作为同一文本中训练的仅限文本的参考文本:平均在1.7B下0.1分,在4B下0.6分(图12.).
编码器,无编码器,和内置配方行为相仿.
在匹配的寿命计算中,参考值领先于0.5至3.9分(表27),因为多式联运培训将其序列的30%提供给了图像-文本数据,因此文本符号减少约30%。
因此,愿景的文本成本几乎超出它所取代的文本数据。

blocks.en: Figure 12: At the same text-token budget, the multimodal recipes score about as well on Avg. Text as the text-only reference. Each point is one decayed endpoint, placed by the text-only tokens it trained on (70% of multimodal training).
blocks.zh: 图12:在相同的文本基预算中,多式配方在Avg上也得分。 文本作为文本唯一的参考。 每个点都是由它所训练的只用文字的符号(多式联运培训的70%)所设置的一个衰败终点.

blocks.en: B.4 Held-out losses
blocks.zh: B.4 搁置损失

blocks.en:
We measure losses on two kinds of held-out data, both as per-token negative log-likelihood in nats.
The held-out text and caption losses score unseen samples of the training distributions, and sections 4 , 5.4 and F.3 use them.
Out-of-distribution caption loss scores caption sets outside those distributions, and table 25 reports it.
blocks.zh:
我们用两种数据衡量损失, 两种数据都是按Nats的负对数计算的。
被搁置的文本和标题损失在培训分发的样本中得分未见,第4、5.4和F.3节使用这些样本。
分布外字幕损失分数在分布外设置,表25报告.

blocks.en:
Held-out text loss is the per-token negative log-likelihood on held-out text from the training text corpus, weighted as in the training mixture.
It is scored with the attention masking each model was trained with.
Held-out caption loss is the per-token negative log-likelihood of the regenerated captions of MetaCLIP 1.2 images never used in training, so it samples the training caption distribution.
blocks.zh:
被搁置文本丢失是培训文本库中被搁置文本的逐一负对数,与培训混合物一样加权。
它的分数是每个模型 被训练的注意度。
Hold-out 字幕丢失是 MetaCLIP 1.2 图像在训练中从未使用过的再生成字幕的每盘负日志类型,因此它可以对训练字幕的分发进行样本.

blocks.en:
Out-of-distribution caption loss averages the caption loss of three sets of 5,000 images with equal weight: the COCO validation images with the first of their human reference captions ( Lin et al., 2014 ) , MetaCLIP 1.2 pairs with their original alt-text ( Xu et al., 2024 ) , and images from a licensed stock-photo collection.
It is scored with the attention masking each model was trained with.
blocks.zh:
分布外字幕损失平均为3组5000张等重图像的字幕损失:COCO验证图像以人类参考标题为首(Lin等,2014年),MetaCLIP1.2对并用原取自正文(Xu等,2024年),以及有许可证的库存相片集的图像.
它的分数是每个模型 被训练的注意度。

blocks.en: B.5 ImageNet linear probes
blocks.zh: B.5 图像 净线性探测器

blocks.en:
We use three linear probes on ImageNet-1K ( Deng et al., 2009 ) .
The downstream probe reads the multimodal model with all weights frozen.
It mean-pools the backbone’s final normalized vision-token states and fits an ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -regularized linear classifier on 50 training images per class.
A fixed 10% holdout selects the regularization strength from { 10 − 4 , 10 − 3 , 10 − 2 } \{10^{-4},10^{-3},10^{-2}\} , and the classifier is then refit on all 50,000 images.
We report top-1 accuracy on the full validation split.
The upstream probe ( table 16 ) fits the same classifier to a frozen pretrained encoder before multimodal training.
It mean-pools the encoder’s 256 final normalized patch tokens of a 224 × 224 224\times 224 center crop; for WebSSL, it reads the exponential-moving-average teacher.
The full-data probe applies the DINOv2 linear evaluation ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) to the frozen pretrained encoder, training on the full ImageNet-1K training set.
It gives the upstream accuracy in fig. 9 and section C.3 .
blocks.zh:
我们在ImageNet-1K上使用了3个线性探测器(Deng等,2009年).
下游探测器读取了所有重量被冻结的多式模型.
它意味着将骨干最终正常化的视觉状态集中起来,并适合每班50个训练图像的正规线性分类器。
一个固定的10%的阻力从{10−4,10−3,10−2}}}{10}}}{10}}}}}}}}} 10⁄2}}} 中选择正规化的强度,然后所有5万个图像的分级器都要重置。
我们报告最高一号的精确度 在完全验证分。
上游探测器(表16)在多式联运培训之前,将同一分类器与被冻结的预先训练的编码器相匹配。
它意味着将编码器的256个最终的普通补丁符号集合起来,一个224×224 2.24\times 224的中心作物;对于WebSSL来说,它读取了指数-移动-平均的老师。
全数据探测器将DINOv2线性评价(Oquab等,2024年)应用于被冷冻的预装编码器上,在全图像Net-1K训练集上进行培训.
它以无花果表示上游的准确性. 9和C.3节.

blocks.en: D.3 Richer patch embeddings
blocks.zh: D.3 更丰富的补丁嵌入

blocks.en:
The default encoder-free patch embedding is a single linear projection followed by RMSNorm and a learned gate ( section A.1 ).
We compare it with two richer patch embedding designs: a normalized two-layer projection inspired by Gemma 4 ( Gemma Team, 2026 ) , and a four-layer hierarchical MLP ( Touvron et al., 2022 ) inspired by Inkling ( Thinking Machines
Lab, 2026a ) .
The lower part of table 21 describes each variant.
The normalized two-layer projection changes patch size, resolution, position embeddings, and normalization together.
It normalizes each patch with LayerNorm ( Ba et al., 2016 ) , projects it linearly, adds learned factorized 2D position embeddings, and then applies LayerNorm, a parameter-free RMSNorm, and a linear map into the backbone.
The hierarchical MLP has four linear layers that fold neighboring pixels into channels in stages, with RMSNorm and GELU ( Hendrycks and Gimpel, 2016 ) between them, a final RMSNorm, and no position embedding.
In table 21 , both richer variants read larger images in larger patches ( 768 × 768 768\times 768 in 48 × 48 48\times 48 patches and 640 × 640 640\times 640 in 40 × 40 40\times 40 patches, rather than 224 × 224 224\times 224 in 14 × 14 14\times 14 patches), so they produce the same 16 × 16 16\times 16 grid of 256 vision tokens as the encoder.

blocks.en: D.4 Comparison with prior work

blocks.en:
Prior work, Shukor et al. (2025) , find that encoder-free models match or slightly outperform an encoder trained from scratch, whereas we find that the encoder leads ( section 4 ).
To investigate this discrepancy, we examine two choices in their setup that may work against the encoder, a reduced encoder learning rate and using the averaged validation loss.
We also study a third difference, using alt-text captions rather than regenerated captions.
First, we evaluate the runs of the scaling ladder ( appendix G ) on their averaged loss.
We also retrain the ladder’s 0.6B and 1B backbones, sizes within the range of their study, with a reduced encoder learning rate, alt-text captions, or both ( table 22 ).
Every other setting matches the ladder’s runs, which serve as baselines.
blocks.zh:
先前的工作,Shukor等人(2025年),发现无编码器模型与从零开始训练的编码器相匹配或略胜,而我们发现编码器领先(第4节.
为了调查这种相差之处,我们研究了两个选择,在设置上可能会对编码器起作用,一个是降低编码器的学习率,并使用平均验证损失.
我们还研究第三个区别,使用备选案文标题,而不是重新生成标题。
首先,我们评估梯级(附录G)的运行情况,以衡量其平均损失。
我们还重新训练梯子的0.6B和1B骨干,在他们的研究范围内的大小,并降低编码器的学习率、备选案文标题或两者(表22)。
其他环境都与作为基准的梯子跑道相匹配。

blocks.en:
Shukor et al. (2025) train their from-scratch encoder at a reduced learning rate, the best of the 0.1 × 0.1\times , 0.01 × 0.01\times , and 0.001 × 0.001\times multipliers they compare.
We train the encoder at 0.01 × 0.01\times the backbone’s peak learning rate, and also at 0.1 × 0.1\times at 1B, with the projector at the full rate.
Instruction tuning trains every encoder at its full rate.
We find that lowering the rate shrinks the encoder’s lead ( table 22 ), and most of the drop comes between the full rate and 0.1 × 0.1\times , whereas their sweep starts at 0.1 × 0.1\times and never trains the encoder at the full rate.
At 0.01 × 0.01\times , the encoder is comparable to encoder-free on Avg. VQA at 1B and loses its caption-loss lead entirely at 0.6B.
blocks.zh:
Shukor等人(2025年)以较低的学习率训练出从scratch编码器,是他们比较的0.1×0.1分时数中最优秀的,0.01×0.01分时数,0.001×0.001分时数乘数.
我们以0.01×0.01\时间来训练编码器,这是骨干峰值的学习率,也是以0.1×0.1\时间在1B,投影仪全速学习.
指令调试每节编解码器的全速.
我们发现,降低速率会收缩编码器的领先(表22),而大部分下降发生在全速和0.1×0.1分时之间,而他们的扫码则从0.1×0.1分时开始,从未以全速训练编码器.
在0.01×0.01\时,编码器在Avg. VQA上与无编码器相仿,在0.6B上完全失去标题-损失铅.

blocks.en:
Shukor et al. (2025) fit their scaling laws to validation loss averaged over interleaved, caption, and text data, with captions that are web alt-text.
The text loss does not depend on the image, and in our ladder the interleaved loss barely differs between the encoder and encoder-free.
Differences between vision components therefore have a weaker effect on the average, which makes it a noisier signal for comparing them.
In our scaling ladder, the averaged loss barely separates the encoder from encoder-free, whereas held-out caption loss separates them clearly and tracks Avg. VQA ( fig. 18 ).
At 1.7B and 128 tokens per parameter, the two reach the same averaged loss while the encoder leads by 4.8 Avg. VQA points ( fig. 15 ).

文本丢失并不取决于图像,在我们梯子中,互离损失在编码器和无编码器之间几乎没有区别.
因此,视觉组成部分之间的差异对平均值的影响更弱,从而成为比较这些组成部分的注意信号。
在我们的缩放阶梯中,平均损失几乎无法将编码器与无编码器区分开来,而被搁置的字幕损失则清楚地将它们区分开来并跟踪Avg. VQA(图18).
以每个参数1.7B和128个令牌计算,两者达到相同的平均损失,而编码器领先4.8 Avg. VQA分(图15.

We also train on the images’ original alt-text instead of the regenerated captions, for the encoder and encoder-free alike.
This delays the encoder’s lead, as the two tie on alt-text caption loss up to 32 tokens per parameter.
With both changes (a 0.01 × 0.01\times encoder learning rate and alt-text captions), encoder-free reaches a lower alt-text caption loss than the encoder at both sizes and every budget, by 0.04 to 0.07 nats, as Shukor et al. (2025) report.
Overall, their finding may reflect an under-trained encoder or an averaged loss that can hide its benefit.

blocks.en:
To see where each design processes vision tokens, we probe the 1.7B models at the longest training budget ( fig. 16 ), adapting the probes of Chen et al. (2026) .
For each backbone block, we measure how much the vision tokens change as one minus the cosine similarity between their hidden state before and after the block, and how much attention caption tokens place on them.
In both in-fusion models, vision tokens change mostly in the blocks with vision-only modules and little after them.
The encoder-free model keeps changing them through its early and middle shared blocks.
The encoder’s tokens enter the backbone already processed, so they change mostly in the first few blocks.
After the in-fusion blocks, caption tokens attend to vision tokens more than in the encoder and encoder-free models.
The same pattern holds at a fifth of the training budget.
These probes suggest that in-fusion capacity performs vision-specific processing in its own early blocks and passes stable vision tokens to the shared backbone, whereas an encoder-free model builds them up across its shared layers.
blocks.zh:
为了了解每个设计过程的视觉符号在哪里,我们在最长的训练预算(图16)中探索了1.7B模型,改造了Chen等的探测器(2026年).
对于每个主干块,我们测量视线符号的改变程度, 以1去除它们之间隐藏的状态的相近性, 以及注意的字幕符号在它们上面的相近性。
在两种内聚物模型中,视觉符号的改变大多在只有视觉模块的区块中进行,在它们之后很少.
无编码器模型通过其早期和中间共享块不断改变它们.
编码器的符号输入了已经处理过的骨干,所以它们大多在最初的几个块中变化.
在输入区块后,字幕符号会比编码器和无编码器模型中更注意视觉符号.
同样的情况占培训预算的五分之一。
这些探测器表明,内置能力在自己的早期区块中进行视向特定处理,并将稳定的视向符号传递给共享骨干,而无编码器模型则在共享地层上建起.

blocks.en: Appendix G Scaling ladder

blocks.en:
Section 5.4 tests whether the comparisons of sections 4 and 5 hold as the backbone grows, using a ladder of backbone sizes.
This section gives the ladder’s setup, the scaling laws fitted to it, and how well the laws predict runs they were not fitted on.
blocks.zh:
第5.4节测试第4节和第5节的比较是否随着骨干的增长而增加,使用一个骨干大小的梯子。
这一节说明了梯子的设置、与之相适应的缩放定律,以及法律如何预测它们没有被安装。

blocks.en:
The ladder trains the encoder-free, encoder, and in-fusion recipes under the protocol of section 2 on backbones from 0.6B to 6.4B parameters.
The backbones follow the architecture of the 1.7B backbone, with query heads of dimension 128 spanning the hidden size, half as many key–value heads, and a feed-forward width three times the hidden size.
The vision module grows with the backbone ( table 28 ).
The encoder keeps the proportions of the 1.7B pairing: half the backbone’s hidden size d d , one layer fewer than the backbone, an MLP four times its own width, and round ⁡ ( 0.75 ​ d / 128 ) \mathrm{round}(0.75\,d/128) attention heads of dimension 128.
Its parameter count therefore stays at a nearly fixed ratio to the backbone’s non-embedding parameters.
The in-fusion modules occupy the first round ⁡ ( 8 ​ L / 28 ) \mathrm{round}(8L/28) of the backbone’s L L layers, 29% of the depth, as at 1.7B.
Their widths are set so that they match the encoder’s parameter count.
blocks.zh:
梯子根据关于骨干的第2节协议,从0.6B到6.4B参数,对编码器无编码器,编码器,和内置配方进行训练.
骨干遵循1.7B骨干架构,128维度的查询头跨出隐藏大小,有一半的键-值头,还有3倍于隐藏大小的向导宽度。
视觉模块随着骨干增长(表28)。
编码器保留了1.7B对接的比例:主干线所隐藏的大小为dd的一半,比主干线少了一层,一个MLP是自身宽度的4倍,而圆×(0.75 d/128)\mathrm{round}(0.75\,d/128)是128的注意头.
因此,它的参数数与骨干的非嵌入参数保持了近乎固定的比例.
内接模块占据了主干L层的首轮QQ(8L / 28)\mathrm{round}(8L/28),深度为29%,为1.7B.
它们的宽度被设定为匹配编码器的参数计数 。

blocks.en:
All recipes at a backbone size share one peak learning rate and one batch size ( table 28 ).
The peak learning rate is 3 × 10 − 4 ​ 1.72 × 10 9 / N tot 3\times 10^{-4}\sqrt{1.72\times 10^{9}/N_{\mathrm{tot}}} , rounded, where N tot N_{\mathrm{tot}} is the total backbone parameter count.
The batch size grows by about 1.5 times per backbone size.
Warmup lasts 2 tokens per non-embedding backbone parameter (2 TPP), e.g. , 2.8B tokens for the 1.7B backbone, which has 1.4B non-embedding parameters.
The other settings follow table 8 .
The 1.7B and 4B runs of sections 3 , 4 and 5 instead keep a batch of 1,024 sequences and 4,000 warmup updates at both sizes.
At 1.7B, where the ladder’s batch is also 1,024, each ladder recipe is within two Avg. VQA points of those runs when interpolated to their budgets ( sections 4 and 5 ).
blocks.zh:
所有主干大小的食谱都共享一个峰值学习率和一个批量大小(表28).
峰值学习率为 3 × 10 − 4 1.72 × 10 9 / Ntt 3\times 10^{-4}\-sqt{1.72\times 10^{-9}/N_{\-mathrm{tot}}}-,四舍五入,其中Nt_{\-mathrm{tot}}-为主干参数总计.

其他设置则遵循表8.

在1.7B, 梯子的批量也是1,024个, 每个梯子配方在其中两个Avg. VQA点在它们的预算插入时运行(第4和5节)。

blocks.en:
For Avg. VQA, caption loss, and text loss, we fit a separate law for each recipe.
For the losses it takes the form L ⁡ ( N , D ) = E + A ​ N − α + B ​ D − β L(N,D)=E+A\,N^{-\alpha}+B\,D^{-\beta} ( Hoffmann et al., 2022 ) , with N N the non-embedding backbone parameters and D D the token-equivalents ( section 2.3 ), fitted by minimizing a Huber loss on log loss.
For Avg. VQA, it is linear in ln ⁡ N \ln N and ln ⁡ D \ln D , fitted by least squares.
Each is fitted on the recipe’s 17 ladder runs ( table 30 ).
From 1.7B to 6.4B, encoder-free needs 2.6 to 3.1 times the encoder’s compute on Avg. VQA, 2.4 to 3.8 times on caption loss, and about the same on text loss.
In-fusion needs about the same compute as the encoder on Avg. VQA and text loss, and slightly less on caption loss. Table 31 gives the scaling laws’ errors on every run and on each left-out backbone size.
Fitted on the ladder alone, the caption-loss laws also predict the separately trained 1.7B and 4B runs of sections 3 , 4 and 5 with an average absolute error of 1.6% ( table 32 ).
Their warmup differs from the ladder’s, and at 4B, so do the batch size and the size of the vision module. Figure 19 shows each recipe’s caption-loss law at every backbone size against the runs it is fitted on.
blocks.zh:
对于Avg. VQA,标题损失,和文本损失,我们为每种食谱分别配上一个定律.
就损失而言,其形式为L-(N,D)=E + A N-α + B D-β L(N,D)=E+A\,N----α-B\,D------β) (Hoffmann等,2022年),N N为非嵌入式主干参数,D为代号等同物(第2.3节),通过将木材损失中Huber损失减少到最低程度来安装。
对Avg. VQA来说,它是线性在 QQ N\ln N 和 INQD\ln D 中,由最小平方装配.
每个都安装在食谱的17个阶梯上(表30)。
从1.7B到6.4B,无编码器在Avg. VQA上需要2.6到3.1倍的编码器计算,在字幕损失上需要2.4到3.8倍的编码器计算,在文本损失上则需要大约相同.
输液需要与Avg上的编码器大致相同的计算. VQA和文本丢失,在标题损失上略为减少. 表31列出每次运行和每个左下方主干线大小的缩放定律错误。
单在梯子上,标题-损失法还预测第3、第4和第5节中经过单独培训的1.7B和4B运行,平均绝对误差为1.6%(表32)。
