blocks.en: H.2 Training time
blocks.zh: H.2 培训时间

blocks.en:
Here, we compare the training time of the encoder recipe with encoder-free, in-fusion (FFN-only), and in-fusion.
Training time can be compared in two ways: per-step comparisons fix the number of optimizer updates, whereas equal-FLOP comparisons fix total modeled training compute.
Because encoder computation counts toward that budget, the encoder recipe completes fewer updates at equal FLOPs, so its equal-FLOP time premium is smaller than its per-step premium.
blocks.zh:
在这里,我们比较了编码器配方的训练时间与无编码器,内置(FFN-只)和内置.
培训时间可以有两种方式进行比较:每步比较可以固定优化器更新的数量,而等-FLOP比较可以固定模型化培训的总计算.
因为编码器计算算上这个预算,所以编码器的食谱在等价FLOP时完成的更新较少,所以其等价FLOP时间的溢价比每步溢价要小.

blocks.en:
We measure training time with complete optimizer updates on H200 GPUs with fully sharded data parallelism (FSDP) ( Zhao et al., 2023 ) .
The matched 4B comparison in table 35 runs the four recipes on 32 GPUs with a global batch of 1,024 sequences.
Each row projects training time from measured steady-state update times to the same modeled lifetime compute, 1.04 × 10 22 1.04\times 10^{22} FLOPs (400B token-equivalents at 4B; section A.5 ).
blocks.zh:
我们用H200 GPU的完整最优化更新测量训练时间,并采用完全被压缩的数据并行性(FSDP)(Zhao等,2023年)。
表35中对应的4B比较显示,32个GPU的四种配方,全球批量为1,024个序列。
每行项目的培训时间从测量的稳态更新时间到同一个模型化的寿命计算时间, 1.04 × 10 22 1.04\times 10-QQ-22} FLOPs(400B相当于4B; 第A.5节.).

blocks.en:
Table 35 times the encoder and the in-fusion configurations of table 23 , which match the encoder’s 0.4B vision-only parameters, under the 4B training setup above.
At equal lifetime compute, neither in-fusion variant measurably changes training time relative to encoder-free.
The encoder takes 2.9% longer than encoder-free and 2.6% longer than in-fusion at equal FLOPs.
Per step, the encoder takes 5.3% longer than encoder-free.
Note that the encoder used here is an unoptimized reference implementation, and encoder-specific optimization can narrow its gap.
For instance, a compiled ( Ansel et al., 2024 ) version of the Base encoder in table 5 trains within 0.2% of an in-fusion (FFN-only) model with the same vision-only parameters at 4B.
blocks.zh:
表35是表23的编码器和内置配置的35倍,与编码器的0.4B只视参数相匹配,在上方的4B训练设置下.
在等效寿命计算时,两个内聚变体都不会使培训时间相对于无编码器的时间发生可估量的变化.
编码器需要比无编码器长2.9%,在等同的FLOP下比内聚能长2.6%.
每一步,编码器比无编码器长5.3%.
注意这里使用的编码器是一种不优化的参考执行,而编码器特有的优化可以缩小其差距.
例如,一个编译的(Ansel等,2024年)Base编码器在表5列车中,在容量为0.2%的内聚能(仅限FFN)模型内,在4B时,只限视参数相同.

blocks.en:
Overlapping or pipelining ( Huang et al., 2019 ) the encoder recovers little of its cost.
At 4B, running the next microbatch’s encoder forward pass alongside the backbone hides 20–36% of the encoder’s per-step cost.
Only the forward pass overlaps, because the encoder’s backward pass waits for the backbone’s gradients.
With or without an encoder, a four-stage pipeline has about half the throughput of the encoder recipe under FSDP on the same 32 GPUs.
FSDP optimizations applied to the encoder alone, such as prefetching parameters or skipping gradient synchronization between accumulation steps, change step time by less than 0.7%.
blocks.zh:
重叠或平流(Huang等,2019年) 编码器回收成本很少.
在 4B 时, 运行下一个微批编码器的前进通道与主干并肩, 隐藏了编码器每步成本的 20-36% 。
只有前向传出重叠,因为编码器的后向传出等待主干梯度.
不论有无编码器,四相管路在相同的32个GPU上拥有FSDP下编码器食谱的吞吐量约一半.
FSDP优化仅应用到编码器上,如预取参数或跳过累积步骤之间的梯度同步,变化步入时间小于0.7%.

blocks.en:
Per step, encoder-free and in-fusion (FFN-only) both train faster than the encoder recipe.
Encoder-free saves more because the vision-only FFNs of in-fusion (FFN-only) cost about 95% of the encoder’s FLOPs.
In an 8-GPU setup at 1.7B, raising the proportion of image–text data from 10% to 50% widens encoder-free’s saving from 10.0% to 13.2%, while in-fusion (FFN-only) saves 6–7% throughout ( fig. 20 ).
blocks.zh:
每一步,无编码和内接(FFN-只)都比编码器配方快.
无编码器的节省更多,因为只用于视觉的入聚(FFN-只)的FFN花费了约95%的编码器的FLOP.
在1.7B的8-GPU设置中,将图像文本数据的比例从10%提高到了50 % , 将无编码器的储蓄率从10.0%提高到了13.2%,而内聚(仅限FFN)则在整个(图20)中节省了6–7%。

blocks.en: H.3 Inference latency
blocks.zh: H.3 推断延迟

blocks.en:
Section 6.3 compares how fast each recipe serves image requests.
We run every design in our own implementation on one H200, so all designs share the same inference code.
Each request has one image and 256 text tokens and generates 120 tokens.
Largely following the inference benchmark setup of Mono-InternVL ( Luo et al., 2025b ) , we report time to first token (TTFT) and output throughput with 16 concurrent requests and 448-pixel images (1,024 vision tokens) unless noted.
Each configuration is measured in four runs, and we report medians with full ranges.
blocks.zh:
第6.3节比较了每种食谱满足图像要求的速度。
我们用一个H200来运行我们自己执行的每一个设计, 所以所有的设计都具有相同的推论代码。
每个请求都有一个图像和256个文本符号,生成120个符号.
主要遵循Mono-InternVL(Luo等,2025b)的推论基准设置,我们报告时间为第一地标(TTFT),输出吞吐量为16个同时请求和448个像素图像(1,024个视觉符号),除非注明.
每个配置按4个跑来测量,我们报告全程中位数。

blocks.en:
Without a separate encoder, the backbone no longer waits for each image to be encoded, so TTFT falls ( fig. 21 ).
In-fusion (FFN-only) still processes every vision token with its vision-only FFNs, and at matched vision-only parameters, it performs approximately the same computation per image as the encoder.
Its advantage comes from running in eight wide layers instead of the encoder’s deeper stack of narrower layers (27 at the 0.4B budget), in our eager-mode implementation.
The inference time saving grows with resolution, because more vision tokens make the encoder a larger share of the time to first token.

In-fusion is faster than the encoder at every budget.

Its relative inference time saving is smaller at 4B only because the backbone’s own prefill time is longer.
